comparison.objective: Deploy a two-section folding ramp between the floor and top of a step; candidate removes and contains insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Large articulated-object unfolding and support placement versus small recessed-tool alignment, bimanual hammering, fracture control, and recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Ramp spans floor to step in a usable configuration versus four fractures, four tray-contained tangs, and intact shell/inserts. Detailed ramp stability thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Articulated ramp deployment tests a meaningfully different physical ability.
